data.long_meaning: The name Jovelin comes from the Latin word 'Jovis', which means 'Jupiter', and the word 'amor', which means 'love'. This name was given to children born under the protection and blessing of Jupiter, the Roman god of the sky and thunder. The name Jovelin carries the meaning “Jovis (Jupiter) + amor (love)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Jovelin usually hope their child will grow to embody jovis (jupiter) + amor (love) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
